meta.purpose: Five events, defined before any code ships, so that 'which page works' becomes a question with an answer.
meta.status: Implemented, disabled on static GitHub Pages.
principles: No cookies, browser storage or visitor identifiers
meta.explicitly_out_of_scope: Reported orders, revenue and conversion rate. Those can only come from the Associates dashboard or the API, which this session cannot read. The campaign ledger starts empty and stays empty until authorised first-party reports exist.

events.name: outbound_product_click
events.fires_when: An armed product link is activated: a link carrying the Associates tag and the data-affiliate-ref identifier. While the paid-link gate is closed the site publishes untagged listing links with no ref attribute, and _tools/check.py fails the build if one is published with a ref - so today this event has nothing to fire on, by design rather than by oversight.
events.answers: Which approved product links receive clicks. A click count is not attribution: nothing here shows whether a click became an order or earned a commission.
not_collected: anything after the click; the destination is Amazon's, not ours
events.blocked_by: Q-03 and S-01: the tracking tag has to be confirmed on an enrolled account and one Special Link tested before a counted click means anything. See S-30 for the alternative the owner may prefer.

events.name: guide_read_75
events.fires_when: The viewport reaches 75% of the main guide section
events.answers: Which guides reach the depth threshold (not proof of reading)
not_collected: time per paragraph, scroll path, mouse movement

events.name: compare_view
not_collected: individually identifying data of any kind

collector_design.payload: Array of event, page and product records; product is null except for a click
collector_design.retention: UTC daily aggregates only; approve and enforce a retention period before enabling
collector_design.opt_out: Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control headers must be honoured by skipping the send
collector_design.why_not_deployed: GitHub Pages cannot run a process; a first-party HTTPS host and approved privacy controls are required.

rules: a row is added only when the figure comes from an authorised first-party report
every row carries the date the figure was pulled and the report it came from
no projection, no forecast, no model output is permitted in this table
reported_orders is left blank until the Associates report provides it
